first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, so simplifying onboarding directly targets both current problems. Prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing signup fields improved time-to-value and durable first-week activation. I will verify those records before committing. Promotional pricing is not preferred because it previously reduced 30-day retention, creating downstream qualified-revenue risk.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification experiment for SMB and other simple-workspace accounts, where prior evidence shows improved activation and qualified revenue. Exclude complex-workspace accounts because the archived shortened-flow test increased 60-day churn there by 9%. Monitor onboarding completion, activation, qualified revenue, and retention before expanding. This directly addresses the current completion and activation declines while avoiding broad promotional pricing, which previously harmed retention.
